not tracking everything against a number, just the two things that actually
worry me:

- eating out / coffee: want to keep this under $260 a month. it's been

- amazon/shopping in general: it's probably my biggest category overall but

everything else (groceries, gas, subscriptions, etc) i'm not budgeting
against a specific number right now, just want to see where it's going.

mkdir -p "$SCRATCH" 2>/dev/null; cd "C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/prompt-evals-session-jfvecc_w"; cat > "C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/C--Users-<user>-AppData-Local-Temp-prompt-evals-session-jfvecc-w/dfb15729-7a41-4712-b268-c5f1f10a65d1/scratchpad/a.py" <<'EOF'
import re,collections
cats={
'Groceries':["Trader Joe","Aldi","Kroger","Costco","Whole Foods"],
'Dining & Coffee':["Local Coffee","Chipotle","McDonald","Rustic Tap","Panera","Sushi Kame","Thai Orchid","Starbucks","Bagel Corner","Luigi"],
'Shopping':["Amazon","Best Buy","Target","REI","Old Navy","Barnes","IKEA","Home Depot"],
'Gas & Auto':["Shell","Chevron","BP Gas","Jiffy"],
'Transport':["Lyft","Uber","Parking"],
'Subscriptions & Bills':["iCloud","Prime","Xfinity","Netflix","Verizon","Spotify Premium","Steam"],
'Fitness & Health':["Planet Fitness","Physical Therapy","Walgreens","CVS","Dental"],
'Entertainment':["Spotify Concert","AMC","Bowl","Ticketmaster"],
'Travel':["Delta","Marriott","Hertz"],
'Transfers & Cash':["Zelle","Venmo","PayPal","ATM"],
}
mon={'Jun':'Jun','Jul':'Jul','Aug':'Aug'}
rows=[]
for ln in open('personal_expenses.txt').read().splitlines()[3:]:
    if not ln.strip(): continue
    amt=re.findall(r'-?\$?\d+\.\d\d',ln)
    # amount: pick token with $ or decimals not part of date
    s=re.sub(r'20\d\d-\d\d-\d\d','',ln)
    s=re.sub(r'\d{1,2}/\d{1,2}(/\d{2})?','',s)
    s=re.sub(r'\b\d\d-\d\d\b','',s)
    s=s.replace('200GB','')
    a=re.findall(r'(-?)\$?(\d+\.\d\d)\b',s)
    sign,v=a[-1]
    v=float(v)*(-1 if '-$' in s and 'Return' in ln else 1)
    m=None
    mm=re.search(r'20\d\d-(\d\d)-\d\d',ln) or re.search(r'\b(\d\d)-\d\d\b',ln) or re.search(r'\b(\d{1,2})/\d{1,2}',ln)
    if mm: m={6:'Jun',7:'Jul',8:'Aug'}[int(mm.group(1))]
    else:
        m=re.search(r'(Jun|Jul|Aug)',ln).group(1)
    c=[k for k,l in cats.items() if any(x.lower() in ln.lower() for x in l)]
    if len(c)!=1: print("CAT?",c,ln)
    rows.append((m,c[0] if c else '?',v,ln))
print(len(rows))
t=collections.defaultdict(float);n=collections.Counter()
for m,c,v,l in rows: t[(c,m)]+=v;n[m]+=1
print(n)
for c in list(cats):
    r=[t[(c,m)] for m in('Jun','Jul','Aug')]
    print(f"{c:24}",*[f"{x:9.2f}" for x in r],f"{sum(r):10.2f}")
for m in('Jun','Jul','Aug'): print(m,round(sum(v for mm,c,v,l in rows if mm==m),2))
print(round(sum(r[2] for r in rows),2))
for m,c,v,l in rows:
    if c=='Dining & Coffee' : print(m,v,l)
